The '''NR2 gully jumper''', also known as the '''NR2 light transport''', was a vessel produced by [[Celestial Industries]] and used by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Great Galactic War]].

==Characteristics==
A larger version of the similar [[Rendaran-class assault shuttle|''Rendaran''-class assault shuttle]], the NR2 gully jumper was a long-range shuttle used by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Great Galactic War]]. The boarding ramp was located in the "chin" of the craft.<ref name="Deceived" />

==History==
[[File:SithWarriors-Deceived.png|thumb|right|200px|[[Adraas]] and his [[Sith Warrior]] strike team disembark from a crashed Republic shuttle.]]
When the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]] [[Sacking of Coruscant|launched an attack]] on the Republic [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], they crashed a stolen gully jumper through the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] main entrance. When the shuttle came to a stop, the boarding hatch opened to reveal a horde of [[Sith Warrior]]s, led by Lord [[Adraas]], who proceeded to engage the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] in a pitched battle that left the temple in ruins.<ref name="Deceived" />
